preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 100,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range of vertex indices.
The integer written on each edge is between 0 and 10^18, inclusive.
No edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum over modulo 10^9 + 7 of the values of s over all interesting triples.
